profile.summary: Software Engineer at Meta's Fintech org

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain critical payments softwares systems on Meta's FinTech org that collect $200B yearly revenue

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain critical payments softwares systems on Meta's FinTech org that collect $200B yearly revenue

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I developed a program capable of using Google's advanced processors on image rendering. I worked over JPEG's open source code, linked it to Google's internal infrastructure, and designed and ran benchmark testing to analyze processing efficiency and speed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked in a multidisciplinary team, developing an interactive tool that allowed users to surface content related to Facebook's Workplace customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked in Microsoft's Mixed Reality team, developing user-friendly interfaces for the company's partners.

positions.title: Software Associate
positions.description: I worked in Facebook's distributed systems team. I was in charge of designing and developing a load balancer. I was also in charge of running benchmarks and analyzing its efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked in the company's Mixed Reality team. I was in charge of developing Xbox Avatars for Microsoft's Hololens and integrating it with the Avatar's mobile app.

positions.title: Summer jobs
positions.description: Assistant on investigation projects in both summer 2015 and 2016. Gained experience in text mining, sentiment analysis, and document edition through TEX code, as well as ability to investigate, practice and learn new programming languages and interfaces individually in a limited period of time.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Baccalaureate of Computer Science and Technology (BCT)

honors.title: ICPC 2020 World Final Classification
honors.description:
- I participated with a new team in the ICPC 2020 regionals (held in 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic).
- We ended up in 1st place among all Mexico teams, and 2nd place among all Latin America teams (including South
America).
- With our remarkable performance, we earned a place in the Dhaka, Bangladesh ICPC World Finals, which will be held
in November, 2022.

honors.title: ICPC 2019 World Finalist
honors.description:
- More than 16,000 teams from over 110 countries annually participate in ICPC. Roughly over 100 of them make it to the
Finals. My team (me and two colleagues) were one of those finalists.
- University & Regional Champion: To classify to the finals, our team went through two elimination rounds:
- Local Stage: I competed against teams in my university (Tecnologico de Monterrey).
- Regional Stage: I competed against teams in my continental region (Mexico and Central America).
My team scored 1st place in both the Local and Regional round.
